const r = await tools.exec_command({
  cmd: "set -euo pipefail
manifest=.ai/task/repair-w20-20260923/PACK-MANIFEST.json
root=evidence/quality/repair-window-20-20260923/orchestration
bad=0
existing=0
while IFS=$'\t' read -r src rel want_sha want_bytes; do actual_sha=$(sha256sum "$src" | cut -d' ' -f1); actual_bytes=$(wc -c < "$src"); if [ "$actual_sha" != "$want_sha" ] || [ "$actual_bytes" != "$want_bytes" ]; then echo "SOURCE_MISMATCH $src $actual_sha/$actual_bytes expected $want_sha/$want_bytes"; bad=1; fi; dst="$root/$rel"; if [ -e "$dst" ]; then existing=$((existing+1)); if ! cmp -s "$src" "$dst"; then echo "TARGET_CONFLICT $dst"; bad=1; fi; fi; done < <(jq -r '.files[] | [.source,.relative_destination,.sha256,(.bytes|tostring)] | @tsv' "$manifest")
echo "PACK_PREFLIGHT files=$(jq '.files|length' "$manifest") existing=$existing bad=$bad"
for rel in evidence/production-review-v2-lite/catalog/entries.jsonl evidence/production-review-v2-lite/catalog/exclusions.jsonl evidence/production-review-v2-lite/catalog/manifest.json i18n/quality/production-review-v2-lite/catalog-v1.schema.json i18n/quality/production-review-v2-lite/policy-v1.json; do src=".artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window20-20260923-candidate-catalog/$rel"; test -f "$src"; echo "CATALOG_SOURCE $(sha256sum "$src") bytes=$(wc -c < "$src") target=$rel"; done
migration=.artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window20-20260923-migration.json
test -f "$migration"; echo "MIGRATION_SOURCE $(sha256sum "$migration") bytes=$(wc -c < "$migration")"
for src in .ai/task/repair-w20-20260923/PUBLICATION-SCOPE.md .ai/task/repair-w20-20260923/CATALOG-CHANGE-VERIFICATION.json .ai/task/repair-w20-20260923/MIGRATION-HOST-VERIFICATION.json .ai/task/repair-w20-20260923/TRANSLATION-COMMIT.json .ai/task/repair-w20-20260923/ADJUDICATION-R0.json .ai/task/repair-w20-20260923/ADJUDICATION-F1.json .ai/task/repair-w20-20260923/ADJUDICATION-R2.json .ai/task/repair-w20-20260923/ADJUDICATION-FINAL.json .artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window20-20260923-queue-1.log .artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window20-20260923-queue-1-timing.json .artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window20-20260923-catalog.log .artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window20-20260923-catalog-timing.json .artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window20-20260923-migration.json .artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window20-20260923-migration-timing.json .artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window20-20260923-migration-run.log .artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window20-20260923-migration-run-timing.json; do test -f "$src"; echo "PUBLICATION_SOURCE $(sha256sum "$src") bytes=$(wc -c < "$src")"; done
test "$bad" -eq 0",
  workdir: "/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation",
  yield_time_ms: 10000,
  max_output_tokens: 12000,
  sandbox_permissions: "require_escalated",
  justification: "允许我执行只读的逐项 SHA/字节预检，确认所有冻结源有效且既有目标无冲突后再复制吗？"
});
text(r.output);
